blocks.en: Abstract
blocks.zh: 摘要

blocks.en: Gait biometrics aims at identity recognition by appearance or pose features captured during unconstrained human walking. Existing methods predominantly rely on binary silhouette images, inherently characterized by low information entropy, and fail to fully utilize the dynamic information in gait sequences, limiting their ability to handle cross-time variations effectively. Consequently, these methods encounter significant challenges in the wild. They are susceptible to variations in clothing, carried objects, and viewpoints, as well as dynamic environmental conditions, all of which lead to substantial degradation in recognition accuracy and robustness. To overcome these challenges, we propose a pose-knowledge-aware approach specifically designed for robust gait recognition in the wild. First, we propose a novel Dynamic Pose-Parsing enhanced Silhouette gait representation paradigm that substantially enhances the information entropy and effectively captures fine-grained behavioral cues by integrating pose-parsing cues with traditional silhouettes. Subsequently, we develop a dual-branch Dynamic Pose-Knowledge-Aware Gait network. The framework consists of two complementary branches: (1) a 2D dynamic pose-aware branch that extracts pose-enhanced features from our proposed DPPS representations, and (2) a 3D Skinned Multi-Person Linear branch that leverages the 3D SMPL model to capture rich and comprehensive 3D dynamic pose information. Finally, the features are integrated to facilitate accurate and robust gait recognition. Extensive experiments on four challenging in-the-wild gait datasets demonstrate the effectiveness and generalizability of the proposed DPPS representation. The complete framework is further evaluated on SUSTech1K, CCPG, and Gait3D, where SMPL information is available or can be consistently estimated, achieving competitive performance under diverse real-world conditions.
blocks.zh: 盖特生物鉴别技术旨在通过外表识别身份,或在不受限制的人类行走过程中所捕捉到的特征。 现有方法主要依靠二进制的silhouette图像,其内在特征为低信息 en,未能充分利用步态序列中的动态信息,限制了它们有效处理跨时变异的能力. 因此,这些方法在野外遇到重大挑战。 它们易受服装、携带物体和观点以及动态环境条件变化的影响,所有这些都导致识别准确性和稳健性大幅退化。 为了克服这些挑战,我们提议一种姿态知识意识办法,专门用来在野外强有力地迅速承认。 首先,我们提出一个新的动态Pose-Parsing增强Silhouette gait代表范式,通过将姿势平缓提示与传统的Silhouette组合起来,大大增强信息 en,有效地捕捉到精细的行为提示. 随后,我们开发了双分支动态Pose-Knowledge-Aware Gait网络. 框架由两个互补分支组成:(1)一个2D动态姿态意识分支,从我们拟议的DPPS表达中提取了姿势增强的特征;(2)一个3D皮肤多人线分支,利用3D SMPL模型获取丰富全面的3D动态呈现信息. 最后,这些特征被综合起来,以促进准确和有力的进度识别。 对四个具有挑战性的 " 快速 " 数据集进行的广泛试验表明,拟议的DPPS代表具有效力和普遍性。 完整的框架将在SUSTech1K、CCPG和Gait3D上得到进一步评价,那里有SMPL信息或能够一致估计,在不同的现实世界条件下实现竞争业绩。

blocks.en: 1 Introduction
blocks.zh: 导言

blocks.en: Gait recognition is a biometric technique that identifies individuals based on their walking patterns. Owing to its unique advantages in non-cooperative, long-distance, and low-resolution scenarios, gait recognition has attracted increasing attention in recent years [ 16 , 3 , 54 , 2 ] . Unlike other biometric traits such as face [ 40 ] , finger vein [ 13 , 12 ] , palmprint [ 9 ] , and hand gesture [ 33 ] , gait recognition does not require subject cooperation and is inherently difficult to disguise or imitate. These characteristics make it particularly well-suited for applications in public security, surveillance, forensic investigation, and medical rehabilitation [ 54 , 29 ] . The release of large-scale gait datasets such as GREW [ 54 ] , Gait3D [ 50 ] , and SUSTech1K [ 32 ] , along with the development of open-source toolkits like OpenGait [ 6 ] and its associated benchmark model, has greatly advanced gait recognition research through systematic evaluations and standardized comparisons.
blocks.zh: Gait识别是一种生物鉴别技术,根据个人的行走规律来识别个人. 由于在不合作、长途和低分辨率的情景中具有独特的优势,近年来速度识别越来越受到关注[16、3、54、2]。 与其他生物特征不同,如脸[40],指脉[13],12],手印[9],手势[33],步态识别不需要主题合作,本质上难以伪装或模仿. 这些特点使其特别适合在公共安全、监视、法医调查和医疗康复方面提出申请[54、29]。 GREW [54],Gait3D [50],SUSTech1K [32]等大型步态数据集的发布,以及OpenGait [6] 等开源工具包及其相关基准模型的开发,通过系统评价和标准化比较,大大推进了步态识别研究.

blocks.en: Despite substantial progress achieved under controlled indoor conditions, gait recognition in unconstrained real-world environments (i.e., in-the-wild) remains highly challenging [ 50 , 32 , 7 , 5 ] . Numerous studies have shown that many SOTA approaches, such as GaitSet [ 3 ] and GaitGL [ 23 ] , which perform well on indoor datasets like CASIA-B [ 47 ] and OU-MVLP [ 36 ] , suffer significant performance degradation when deployed on outdoor datasets such as Gait3D [ 50 ] and SUSTech1K [ 32 ] . This performance gap largely stems from the complexity of real-world conditions, where factors like clothing variation, inconsistent lighting, dynamic occlusion, and viewpoint changes impair the stability of appearance features and hinder the extraction of robust discriminative representations.
blocks.zh: 尽管在受控制的室内条件下取得了实质性进展,但在不受约束的现实世界环境中(即 " 无所不在 " ),快速识别仍然极具挑战性[50、32、7、5]。 许多研究表明,许多SOTA方法,例如GaitSet [3]和GaitGL [23],在CASIA-B [47]和OU-MVLP [36]等室内数据集上表现良好,在Gait3D [50]和SUSTech1K [32]等室外数据集上部署时,性能严重退化。 这一性能差距主要源于现实世界条件的复杂性,在现实世界中,服装变化、照明不统一、动态隔离和观点变化等因素会损害外观特征的稳定性,并妨碍提取强烈的歧视性表述。

blocks.en: Most gait recognition methods rely on binary silhouettes (abbreviated as Sils ) [ 3 , 8 ] , which, despite capturing body contours, suffer from low information entropy and structural sparsity [ 5 , 51 ] , as shown in Table 1 . Most local patches in binary silhouettes exhibit uniform pixel value distributions, either all 0s or all 255s. These regions encode neither body shape nor structural semantics, leading to embedding vectors that are effectively zero or constant ( Unit Vectors ), as shown in Fig. 1 . In DeepGaitV2 [ 5 ] , the authors termed these as dumb patch , where the input provides little or no information to the model. Pose skeletons offer strong priors and better robustness to viewpoints, but lack dense temporal cues. Skinned Multi-Person Linear (SMPL) models provide richer 3D information but are high-dimensional and not directly suitable for recognition [ 26 ] . ParsingGait [ 51 ] addressed this by proposing high-entropy semantic representations. These trends highlight the need for more informative, compact, and identity-discriminative modalities under real-world conditions.
blocks.zh: 大部分的步态识别方法依赖于二进制斜拉片(缩写为Sils)[3,8],尽管捕捉到身体轮廓,但如表1所示,它仍然受到低信息 en和结构痉挛[5,51]. 大多数二进制的本地补丁都显示出统一的像素值分布,要么全部0s,要么全部255s. 这些区域既不编码身体形状,也不编码结构语义,导致嵌入有效为零或恒定的向量(Unit Vectors ),如图1所示. 在DeepGaitV2 [5]中,作者称这些为哑补丁,其中输入为模型提供的信息很少或根本没有. Pose骨架为观点提供了强大的前科和更好的坚固性,但缺乏密集的时间提示. 皮肤多人线(SMPL)模型提供了更丰富的3D信息,但具有高维度,不直接适合识别[26]. ParsingGait[51]通过提出高调语义表述来解决这一问题。 这些趋势突出表明,需要在现实世界条件下采取更加翔实、紧凑和区别身份的方式。

blocks.en: Beyond appearance, gait encodes behavioral biometric traits such as stride frequency and limb motion amplitude [ 19 , 49 , 42 ] , which are often invariant to clothing and viewpoint changes. These cues carry strong identity signals. However, prior works [ 49 , 18 ] highlight that appearance and pose features are often entangled, necessitating a more interpretable fusion strategy. Also, SMPL-based methods [ 19 , 50 ] have demonstrated the potential of modeling 3D dynamics, but often suffer from coarse feature fusion and lack explicit structural guidance. To this end, better utilization of compact SMPL parameters for dynamic modeling remains an open challenge [ 20 ] .
blocks.zh: 除了外表外,步法还编码了行为生物特征,如脚步频率和四肢运动振幅[19,49,42],这些特征往往对衣着和视线变化不具有变化性. 这些提示带有强大的身份信号. 然而,先前的作品[49,18]强调,外观和姿势特征往往缠绕在一起,因此需要有一种更能解释的聚变策略. 另外,基于SMPL的方法[19,50]也证明了建模3D动力学的潜力,但经常受到粗糙的特征聚变,缺乏明确的结构指导. 为此,更好地利用紧凑的SMPL参数进行动态建模仍然是一个公开的挑战[20]。

blocks.en: To address the aforementioned challenges, we introduce a high-entropy representation termed Dynamic Pose-Parsing Enhanced Silhouette (DPPS), which overlays pose structures onto silhouettes to embed semantic topology and structural cues. Fig. 1 demonstrates how the same patch region, when enhanced via DPPS, retains clear intra-patch variations. These variations correspond to meaningful joint and limb patterns, thereby increasing the local entropy of pixel values. The resulting dense embeddings are no longer uniform, but capture fine-grained motion-aware cues and convey stronger discriminative power. This semantic compensation mechanism allows DPPS to mitigate the dumb patch issue by embedding structure-aware cues directly into the pixel domain. As a result, the general gait recognition networks can benefit from the augmented representational richness, particularly in occluded or ambiguous walking conditions.
blocks.zh: 为了应对上述挑战,我们引入了一种称为动态松柏加固硅胶(DPPS)的高强度代表,它将结构叠加到硅胶上,以嵌入语义地形和结构提示。 图1显示了同一补丁区域在通过DPPS增强时如何保留明显的区间变化。 这些变化与有意义的关节和四肢模式相对应,从而增加了像素值的局部 en. 由此产生的密集嵌入不再统一,而是捕捉精细的动感提示并传递更强的歧义力量. 这种语义补偿机制允许DPPS通过将结构感知提示直接嵌入像素域来缓解哑补丁问题. 因此,一般的步态识别网络可以受益于代表的丰富性,特别是在被占有或模糊的步行条件下。

blocks.en: Furthermore, to better capture 3D dynamic behaviors from temporal gait sequences, we propose a dual-branch Dynamic Pose-Knowledge-Aware Gait network (DPAGait). The two branches of DPAGait capture complementary semantics and are fused to form a unified, discriminative gait representation. Specifically, the 2D pose-aware branch focuses on structure-enhanced appearance cues derived from DPPS, modeling fine-grained spatial patterns along body contours and articulated parts. In parallel, the 3D SMPL branch encodes pose dynamics and identity-related behavioral characteristics in a canonical 3D space, offering robustness to clothing, viewpoint, and occlusion variations. By integrating these complementary sources through our residual attention fusion module, DPAGait produces a holistic representation that excels under diverse in-the-wild conditions.
blocks.zh: 此外,为了更好地从时步序列中捕捉到3D动态行为,我们提出一个双分支动态Pose-Knowledge-Aware Gait网络(DPAGait). DPAGait的两个分支捕捉到互补的语义,并被融合成一个统一,歧视性的步态代表. 具体来说,2D的姿势意识分支侧重于从DPPS中衍生出来的结构增强外观提示,沿身体轮廓和清晰的部位建模精细的空间图案. 同时,3D SMPL分支编码在犬类3D空间中呈现动态和身份相关行为特征,为服装,视角,以及隐蔽变化提供坚固性. 通过通过我们剩余的关注聚变模块来整合这些互补来源,政治部产生了一种在各种复杂条件下表现优异的整体代表性。

blocks.en: The main contributions of our research are summarized as follows: 1. We propose a novel DPPS representation, which embeds pose-derived structural cues and RankSVM-based local motion dynamics into the silhouette foreground while preserving its original contour and single-channel form. Different from pose heatmaps, parsing maps, and direct multimodal fusion, DPPS performs spatially aligned structure-motion integration at the representation level and remains directly compatible with existing silhouette-based gait recognition backbones. 2. We design a dynamic pose-knowledge-aware dual-stream network that effectively captures both structural and behavioral cues, leveraging the complementary nature of contour and 3D dynamics to enhance structural and motion modeling. 3. Extensive experiments on four large-scale in-the-wild gait datasets demonstrate the effectiveness and generalizability of DPPS, while evaluations of the complete DPAGait framework on SUSTech1K, CCPG and Gait3D further validate the benefits of complementary 2D/3D gait modeling.
blocks.zh: 我们研究的主要贡献概述如下: 1. 我们提议采用新的DPPS代表法,将产生的结构提示和基于RankSVM的局部运动动态嵌入硅色前景,同时保留其原有的轮廓和单通道形式。 DPPS不同于摆设热图,解析地图,以及直接的多模式聚变,在代表级别上进行空间对齐的结构-运动集成,并且仍然直接兼容现有的基于硅的步态识别主干. 2. 我们设计一个动态的姿势-知识-意识双流网络,有效地捕捉结构提示和行为提示,利用轮廓和3D动态的互补性,加强结构和运动建模。 3. 对四个大型的 " 瞬间 " 数据组的广泛试验表明DPPS的有效性和通用性,而对SUSTech1K、CCPG和Gait3D的完整的DPAGait框架的评价进一步验证了互补的2D/3D " 步态模型的效益。

blocks.en: 2 Related Work
blocks.zh: 2 相关工作

blocks.en: 2.1 Gait Representations
blocks.zh: 2.1 盖特代表处

blocks.en: Gait representation serves as a fundamental component of gait recognition systems that directly impacts the model’s capacity for discriminative feature learning and robustness under real-world conditions. Existing approaches typically rely on silhouettes [ 3 , 8 , 11 ] , skeletons [ 7 ] , flow [ 2 ] , dynamic templates such as Gait Energy Images (GEI) [ 10 ] and parsing-based representations [ 51 ] . Among these, the binary silhouettes and skeleton sequences remain the most widely adopted representations. Silhouettes offer a compact abstraction of human shape but inherently suffer from low information entropy, often discarding critical pose details during binarization. Moreover, their performance degrades in challenging scenarios due to foreground jitter, background noise, and occlusion. Temporal templates like GEI and CGI also fall short in modeling subtle temporal dynamics due to their averaging nature. Skeleton-based representations provide a robust encoding of human pose structures and exhibit resilience to appearance variations. However, they lack expressiveness for identity-related shape cues, such as body proportion and contour fidelity. Recent advances attempt to address these issues: SkeletonGait [ 7 ] introduces a Gaussian-based skeletal heatmap to enhance structural detail, while ParsingGait [ 51 ] proposes the Gait Parsing Sequence (GPS), extracting fine-grained part-level parsing maps for more semantically meaningful features. DPGait [ 15 ] extends sparse skeleton representations with human surface points derived from body-mesh priors, and encodes skeleton and surface points as multi-channel heatmaps for dense pose-based gait modeling. Other efforts have explored multi-modal or sensor-based representations such as LiDAR point clouds to enhance 3D structural perception [ 32 ] . However, these approaches often require heavy pre-processing or computationally expensive segmentation networks, limiting their practical deployment in large-scale systems. To this end, we propose a new silhouette representation, DPPS, which fuses skeletal topology with contour appearance in a single image. The DPPS not only retains structural semantics from the pose skeleton but also preserves the appearance fidelity of silhouette contours. This unified design provides a compact, robust, and semantically rich representation tailored for real-world gait recognition.
blocks.zh: 盖特代表制是快速识别系统的一个基本组成部分,它直接影响模型在现实世界条件下的歧视性学习和稳健性。 现有方法一般依靠硅[3,8,11],骨架[7],流[2],动态模板如Gait Energy Images[10]和解析式表达[51]. 其中,二进制的轮廓和骨架序列仍然是最被广泛采纳的表示. Silhouettes提供了人类形状的紧凑抽象,但本质上却受到低信息 en的困扰,在二进制化过程中常常丢弃关键姿势细节. 此外,由于前景紧张、背景噪音和隐蔽性,它们的性能在具有挑战性的情景中下降。 诸如GEI和CGI这样的时间性模板也因为其平均性而在模拟微妙的时间性动态方面有缺陷. 基于Skeleton的表示提供了人类姿势结构的有力编码,并显示出对外观变化的适应能力。 然而,他们缺乏与身份有关的形状提示的表达力,如身体比例和等同忠诚。 最近取得的进展试图解决这些问题: SkeletonGait [7]引入了基于高斯的骨骼热映射来增强结构细节,而ParsingGait [51]则提出了Gait解析序列(GPS),提取精细的分层解析图,用于更精致有意义的特征. DPGait [15] 扩展了稀疏骨架的表示方式,其中人类表面点来自身体-mesh的前身,并将骨架和表面点编码为多通道热图,用于密集的姿势型式型号模型. 其他努力也探索了多模式或基于传感器的表示方式,如LiDAR点云,以增强3D结构感知[32]. 然而,这些方法往往需要大量的预处理或计算成本昂贵的分块网络,限制了它们在大规模系统中的实际部署。 为此,我们提出一个新的Silhouette代表,DPPS,它将骨骼地形与轮廓外观融合在一个单一的图像中. DPPS不仅从姿势骨架上保留了结构语义,还保留了硅胶轮廓的外观忠贞. 这种统一设计提供了一种紧凑、有力和精致的、适合现实世界步态识别的代表性。

blocks.en: 2.2 Gait Recognition Methods
blocks.zh: 2.2 盖特承认 方法

blocks.en: Gait recognition methods are generally categorized into two major paradigms: model-based and appearance-based approaches.
blocks.zh: 盖特识别方法一般分为两大范式:基于模型的方法和基于外观的方法.

blocks.en: Model-based gait recognition methods recognize individuals by explicitly modeling human structural or geometric characteristics. Common representations include 2D/3D skeleton sequences, mesh-based human models, and 3D point clouds [ 39 , 22 , 38 ] . Early works such as Urtasun et al. [ 39 ] proposed 3D temporal motion models for gait analysis, while Yamauchi et al. [ 45 ] employed human body fitting to 3D volumetric data for person recognition. Recent advances have further improved the representational power of structural modeling. PoseGait [ 22 ] integrates 3D skeletons with human prior knowledge to achieve robustness across clothing variations and view changes. GaitGraph [ 38 ] employs Graph Convolutional Networks to extract temporal gait features from skeletal graphs, highlighting the structural advantages of graph modeling. Despite these advances, model-based methods often underperform their appearance-based counterparts on in-the-wild datasets. This performance gap primarily arises from their limited ability to capture appearance-driven gait cues, such as body shape and silhouette dynamics, which are critical under complex real-world conditions.
blocks.zh: 基于模型的步态识别方法通过明确模拟人的结构或几何特征来识别个人. 常见的表示包括2D/3D骨架序列,网基人类模型,以及3D点云[39,22,38]. 早期作品如乌尔塔孙等人. [39] 提出3D时间运动模型用于步态分析,而Yamauchi et al. [45] 使用与3D体积数据相匹配的人体进行人识别. 最近的进展进一步提高了结构建模的代表性。 PoseGait [22] 将3D骨架与人类先前的知识融合,以在服装变异和视图变化之间实现坚固. GaitGraph [38] 雇员 图表 从骨骼图中提取时步特征的网络,突出了图建模的结构优势. 尽管取得了这些进展,但基于模型的方法往往在全天候数据集上,其基于外观的对应方法表现不佳。 这种性能差距主要源于它们捕捉外观驱动的行进提示的能力有限,例如身体形状和硅胶动力学,这些在复杂的现实世界条件下至关重要.

blocks.en: Appearance-based gait recognition methods aim to extract identity-relevant features from raw video sequences, focusing primarily on external contours and body shape dynamics [ 3 , 8 , 5 , 43 , 42 , 4 , 30 , 28 ] . These approaches are particularly effective in low-resolution or uncontrolled environments. The key challenge lies in modeling both spatial and temporal aspects of gait to learn discriminative and stable identity features. Previous works such as GaitSet [ 3 ] introduced a set-based representation of gait sequences with frame-level max-pooling, while GaitPart [ 8 ] further emphasized local body regions using a micromotion capture module to enhance temporal granularity. Fan et al. [ 5 ] proposed DeepGaitV2, which unified multiple backbone strategies to improve robustness in complex scenarios. DyGait [ 43 ] explicitly models dynamic part-level features over time, and GaitGCI [ 4 ] leverages counterfactual learning to suppress confounding regions and highlight informative patterns. RSANet [ 30 ] addresses silhouette quality variation via a relative-sequence quality assessment framework. In contrast to these methods, our approach jointly models dynamic pose knowledge-enhanced appearance features and pose-aware behavioral features derived from the SMPL model. The proposed dual-stream architecture enables fine-grained and structurally guided representation learning, offering improved robustness and discriminability under in-the-wild conditions.

blocks.en: 3.2 Dual-branch Dynamic Pose-Knowledge-Aware Network
blocks.zh: 3.2 双分支动态Pose-Knowledge-Aware网络

blocks.en: To further enhance the modeling of diverse gait-related modalities, we propose a dual-branch Dynamic Pose-Knowledge-Aware Gait network (DPAGait), consisting of a 2D dynamic pose-aware branch and a 3D SMPL branch, as shown in Fig. 2 .
blocks.zh: 为了进一步加强多种步态相关模式的建模,我们提议建立一个双分支动态Pose-Knowledge-Aware Gait网络(DPAGait),由2D动态姿势意识分支和一个3D SMPL分支组成,如图2所示.

blocks.en: 3.2.1 2D Dynamic Pose-Aware Branch
blocks.zh: 3.2.1 2D 动态Pose-Aware分支

blocks.en: The 2D dynamic pose-aware branch is designed to extract pose knowledge-enhanced features from the DPPS representations. Unlike conventional silhouette images, the DPPS preserves the complete outer contour of the human body while explicitly encoding key skeletal structures, enabling the model to perceive shape and geometric pose information simultaneously. This branch focuses on learning fine-grained features enhanced with dynamic pose priors.
blocks.zh: 2D动态姿势意识分支旨在从DPPS的表示中提取姿势增强的知识特征. 与常规的Silhouette图像不同,DPPS保留了人体完整的外形轮廓,同时明确编码了关键骨骼结构,使模型能够同时感知形状和几何形式的信息. 本分支侧重于学习用动态姿势前缀增强的精致特征.

blocks.en: As illustrated in Fig. 2 , we adopt DeepGaitV2-P3D [ 5 ] as the backbone for this branch. DeepGaitV2-P3D consists of five components, including an initial convolutional layer (C0) followed by four stages (S1 - S4). The C0 block applies a 3 × 3 3\times 3 2D convolution to extract low-level features. Stage 1 employs standard 2D residual blocks for shallow spatial encoding, while stage 2 to stage 4 leverage Pseudo-3D (P3D) residual units. Each P3D block decouples 3D convolution into a combination of 1 × 3 × 3 1\times 3\times 3 spatial and 3 × 1 × 1 3\times 1\times 1 temporal convolutions, balancing expressive power and computational efficiency. This design is particularly advantageous for modeling large-scale in-the-wild gait datasets. We further apply Temporal Pooling (TP) and Horizontal Pyramid Pooling (HPP) [ 5 ] to capture multiscale local spatial cues by Eq. blocks.en: 3.2.2 3D SMPL Branch
blocks.zh: 3.2.2 3D SMPL处

blocks.en: The 3D SMPL branch is designed to extract identity-related behavioral representations from 3D human body models, focusing on modeling individual motion patterns in the spatiotemporal domain. The role of this branch is to leverage SMPL-based 3D pose information to provide complementary behavioral cues that are difficult to explicitly characterize using the 2D DPPS representation.
blocks.zh: 3D SMPL分支旨在从3D人体模型中提取与身份有关的行为表现,侧重于在spatiental域中模拟个人运动模式. 这个分支的作用是利用基于SMPL的3D配置信息来提供辅助行为提示,而使用2D的DPPS表示法很难明确定性.

blocks.en: For the Gait3D dataset, we directly use the provided SMPL parameters, while for SUSTech1K and CCPG, we estimate the SMPL parameters from RGB videos via ROMP [ 34 ] . The pose parameters 𝜽 \bm{\theta} encode dynamic 3D pose motion, and the SMPL’s strong statistical priors enable reliable full-body pose recovery, even under partial occlusion. This parameterization offers several advantages for in-the-wild gait recognition, such as occlusion robustness, viewpoint and scale normalization, and behavioral stability. Consequently, even when the same subject appears under different outdoor conditions and clothing, SMPL-driven reconstruction preserves the intrinsic pose dynamics critical for identity discrimination.

blocks.en: 4 Experiments
blocks.zh: 4 实验

blocks.en: 4.1 Datasets
blocks.zh: 4.1 数据集

blocks.en: We evaluate our method on four challenging in-the-wild gait recognition benchmarks: SUSTech1K [ 32 ] , CCPG [ 17 ] , Gait3D [ 50 ] , and GREW [ 54 ] .
blocks.zh: 我们用四个具有挑战性的内行识别基准来评价我们的方法:SUSTech1K [32]、CCPG [17]、Gait3D [50] 和GREW [54]。

blocks.en: An outdoor multimodal dataset with 1,050 subjects and 25,239 sequences captured by synchronized RGB and LiDAR devices.
blocks.zh: 一个室外多式联运数据集,包含1,050个主体和25,239个序列,由同步RGB和LiDAR设备捕获.

blocks.en: A benchmark proposed for cloth-changing person ReID and gait recognition. It includes 200 identities and 16K sequences with fine-grained clothing variation labels.

blocks.en: A large-scale gait dataset collected from 39 surveillance cameras in real-world scenes. It contains 4,000 identities and over 25,000 sequences with frame-wise silhouettes, 2D/3D pose annotations, and SMPL fits.
blocks.zh: 在现实世界的场景中从39个监视摄像机中收集到的大型步态数据集. 它包含4000个身份和超过25000个序列,带有帧式的silhouettes,2D/3D设置说明,SMPL适配.

blocks.en: 4.2 Evaluation Metrics
blocks.zh: 4.2 评价计量

blocks.en: These datasets reflect the practical complexities of real-world gait recognition and serve as rigorous benchmarks for evaluating model generalization and robustness. We adopt commonly used evaluation metrics consistent with prior works, such as Rank-1 accuracy (R-1), Rank-5 accuracy (R-5), Rank-10 accuracy (R-10), mean Average Precision (mAP), and mean Inverse Negative Penalty (mINP).
blocks.zh: 这些数据集反映了现实世界速度识别的实际复杂性,并作为评价模型通俗化和稳健性的严格基准。 我们采用与以往工作相一致的常用评价指标,如Rank-1精度(R-1)、Rank-5精度(R-5)、Rank-10精度(R-10)、平均精度(mAP)和平均反向负罚。

blocks.en: 4.3 Implementation Details
blocks.zh: 4.3 详细执行情况

blocks.en: All experiments are conducted on a deep learning server equipped with four NVIDIA RTX 3090 GPUs (each with 24 GB of memory). Our method is implemented using the PyTorch framework and is modularly developed based on the OpenGait toolbox [ 6 ] for efficient extension and integration. During training, we adopt Stochastic Gradient Descent (SGD) as the optimizer, with an initial learning rate of 0.1 0.1 , a momentum factor of 0.9 0.9 , and a weight decay of 5 × 10 − 4 5\times 10^{-4} . We apply a range of data augmentation techniques to the images during training, including perspective transformation, random horizontal flipping, rotation, cropping, and random erasing [ 6 ] . All input images are resized or cropped to a fixed resolution of 64 × 64 64\times 64 to ensure consistency across the dataset.
blocks.zh: 所有实验都是在配备4台NVIDIA RTX 3090 GPU(每台都有24GB的内存)的深层学习服务器上进行的. 我们的方法使用PyTorch框架实施,并以OpenGait工具箱[6]为基础模块化开发,以高效扩展和集成. 在训练期间,我们采用Stochastic Gradient Egente(SGD)作为优化者,初始学习率为0.1 0.1,动力因子为0.9 0.9,体重衰减为5×10−4 5\times 10^{-4}. 我们在训练期间对图像应用了一系列数据增强技术,包括视角转换、随机水平翻转、旋转、裁剪和随机擦除[6]。 所有输入图像都调整大小或裁剪为64×64 64\times 64的固定分辨率,以确保数据集的一致性.

blocks.en: 4.4 Comparisons with State-of-the-Art Methods
blocks.zh: 4.4 与最新方法的比较

blocks.en: As shown in Table 2 and Table 3 , our proposed DPPS demonstrates clear advantages in both recognition accuracy and computational efficiency compared to other single-modality methods. Specifically, on the SUSTech1K dataset, DPPS achieves the Rank-1 accuracy of 81.3%, surpassing DeepGaitV2-Parsing (77.3%) and DeepGaitV2-Flow (80.5%), while requiring less than half of their computational cost 9.5 GFLOPs vs. 21.9 GFLOPs and 21.0 GFLOPs, respectively, as reported in Table 4 . On the GREW and Gait3D datasets, DPPS also achieved the highest Rank-1 accuracy, at 79.2% and 81.1% respectively. On the CCPG dataset, DPPS attains a Rank-1 accuracy of 85.9%, which is also competitive with representative RGB-based methods. It is worth noting that RGB inputs inherently contain rich appearance cues, but they can also raise privacy concerns in real-world identity recognition. In contrast, DPPS leverages structural and motion semantics from non-RGB modalities, maintaining competitive accuracy while preserving the privacy advantages of silhouette-based representations.
blocks.zh: 如表2和表3所示,与其他单一模式方法相比,我们提议的DPPS在识别准确性和计算效率方面都显示出明显的优势。 具体而言,在SUSTech1K数据集上,DPPS的排名1精度达到81.3%,超过了DeepGaitV2-Parsing(77.3%)和DeepGaitV2-Flow(80.5%),而如表4所示,它们分别需要不到一半的计算成本9.5GFLOPs对21.9GFLOPs和21.0GFLOPs。 在GREW和Gait3D数据集上,DPPS也实现了最高的Rank-1精度,分别为79.2%和81.1%。 在CCPG数据集上,DPPS的排名1精度达到85.9%,这与基于RGB的代表性方法也具有竞争力. 值得注意的是,RGB输入本身包含丰富的外观提示,但它们也可以在现实世界身份识别中引起隐私关切. 相比之下,DPPS利用非RGB模式的结构语义和运动语义,保持竞争性准确性,同时保留基于硅胶的表达的隐私优势.

blocks.en: We further include the recent dense pose-based DPGait [ 15 ] for comparison. By augmenting sparse skeleton keypoints with human surface points, DPGait achieves 85.8% and 92.7% Rank-1 accuracy on SUSTech1K and CCPG, respectively, demonstrating the effectiveness of dense pose modeling. In comparison, DPPS follows a different representation paradigm: rather than increasing the density of pose points, it embeds pose-derived structural and dynamic cues into the silhouette foreground while retaining a compact single-channel representation that is directly compatible with existing silhouette-based gait recognition backbones. Although DPGait achieves higher in-domain accuracy on SUSTech1K and CCPG, DPPS provides a simpler silhouette-compatible representation and demonstrates improved cross-dataset transferability, as further validated in Table 5 .
blocks.zh: 我们进一步将最近密集的姿势DPGait[15]列为比较对象。 DPGait通过用人类表面点来扩充稀疏的骨架键位,在SUSTech1K和CCPG上分别取得了85.8%和92.7%的Rank-1精度,证明了密集的姿势模型设计的效果. 相比而言,DPPS遵循了不同的代表范式:它不是增加姿势点的密度,而是将姿势衍生的结构性和动态提示嵌入硅色前景,同时保留一个紧凑的单通道代表,直接兼容现有的基于硅色的步态识别主干. 虽然DPGait在SUSTech1K和CCPG上实现了更高的域内精确度,但DPPS提供了一种更简单的与硅相容的表示,并显示改进了跨数据集的可转移性,如表5进一步验证.

blocks.en: Furthermore, DPPS demonstrates promising generalization ability when integrated into multimodal architectures. In the powerful MultiGait++ backbone, replacing silhouette, parsing, and flow with DPPS significantly improves Rank-1 accuracy, indicating that DPPS effectively complements other modalities through semantically enriched yet lightweight representations. Compared to SMPLGait, which also utilizes SMPL parameters, DPAGait achieves an 11.0% performance improvement on SUSTech1K (85.6% vs. 74.6%), a 20.5% improvement on CCPG (86.4% vs. 65.9%), and a 35.3% improvement on Gait3D (81.6% vs. 46.3%), highlighting the advantages of dynamic pose knowledge modeling and two-stream fusion based on residual attention mechanisms. These results collectively demonstrate that DPPS provides a compact yet discriminative representation method, offering a promising alternative when dense parsing or optical flow annotations are difficult to obtain. To further evaluate the effectiveness of the dual-branch architecture, we introduce DPPS into SMPLGait, which also adopts a dual-branch framework with 2D gait representations and 3D SMPL parameters. As shown in Table 2 and Table 3 , replacing silhouette with DPPS improves the Rank-1 accuracy of SMPLGait from 74.6% to 77.6% on SUSTech1K, from 65.9% to 67.3% on CCPG, and from 46.3% to 59.3% on Gait3D. These consistent improvements on another existing dual-branch framework provide further experimental support for the effectiveness of dual-branch modeling with DPPS and SMPL.
blocks.zh: 此外,DPPS在融入多式联运结构时,显示出很有希望的普遍化能力。 在强大的MultiGait++骨干中,用DPPS取代硅液,解析,流化,大大提高了Rank-1的精度,表明DPPS通过精致的浓缩而轻量级的表示来有效补充其他模式. 与SMPLGait(也使用SMPL参数)相比,DPAGait在SUSTech1K(85.6%对74.6%)的性能改进率为11.0%,在CCPG(86.4%对65.9%)的改进率为20.5%,在Gait3D(81.6%对46.3%)的改进率为35.3%,凸显了动态形成知识模型和基于剩余关注机制的双流聚的优点。 这些结果集体表明,DPPS提供了一种紧凑但具有歧视性的表示方法,在难以获得密集的剖析或光学流注时,提供了一个有希望的替代办法。 为了进一步评价双分支架构的有效性,我们将DPPS引入SMPLGait,它也采用了带有2D步态表示和3D SMPL参数的双分支框架. 如表2和表3所示,用DPPS取代SMPLGait的Rank-1精度提高,SUSTech1K的精度从74.6%提高到77.6%,CCPG的精度从65.9%提高到67.3%,Gait3D的精度从46.3%提高到59.3%。 对另一个现有双分支框架的这些一致改进为与DPPS和SMPL的双分支建模的有效性提供了进一步的实验支持.

blocks.en: 4.5 Comparison Between DPPS and Silhouette Inputs
blocks.zh: 4.5 DPPS和Silhouette输入的比较

blocks.en: As shown in Fig. 4 , we evaluate the effectiveness of the proposed DPPS representation by comparing it with traditional silhouette inputs across several representative single-stream baseline models, including GaitSet [ 3 ] , GaitPart [ 8 ] , GaitGL [ 23 ] , GaitBase [ 6 ] , and DeepGaitV2 [ 5 ] . Experimental results consistently demonstrate that DPPS improves gait recognition performance across all four benchmark datasets, using five baseline models, thereby validating its discriminative ability under diverse and challenging conditions.
blocks.zh: 如图4所示,我们评价拟议的DPPS代表的有效性,方法是与几个具有代表性的单流基线模型,包括GaitSet [3]、GaitPart [8]、GaitGL [23]、GaitBase [6] 和DeepGaitV2 [5] 的传统Silhouette投入进行比较。 实验结果一致表明,DPPS利用五个基准模型,在所有四个基准数据集中改进了速度识别性能,从而验证其在多样化和具有挑战性条件下的歧视性能力。

blocks.en: On SUSTech1K, DPPS yields remarkable performance gains over silhouette inputs, particularly for GaitGL, which improves by 14.1 percentage points in Rank-1 accuracy. On Gait3D, DPPS demonstrates consistent improvements across all baseline datasets, with an average performance improvement of up to 8.4 percentage points. Even on Gait3D, the robust DeepGaitV2 backbone achieves a further 6.7 percentage points increase (from 74.4% to 81.1%). Similarly, on GREW, the average improvement in DPPS is as high as 4.8 percentage points.

blocks.en: These consistent gains across datasets stem primarily from the structural priors and semantic completeness provided by DPPS. Unlike traditional silhouettes that only encode coarse outer contours, DPPS embeds human skeletal topology within the silhouette foreground, effectively recovering missing local body regions (e.g., occluded limbs or motion-blurred parts) and strengthening the representation of anatomically essential joints. This skeleton-guided enrichment provides a geometry-aware prior that stabilizes silhouette quality and guides alignment. Moreover, by fusing structural semantics with silhouette contours, DPPS substantially increases the input’s information entropy, enabling downstream networks to capture more motion cues with limited receptive fields.
blocks.zh: 数据集的这些持续收益主要来自DPPS提供的结构前科和语义完整性. 与传统的仅编码粗糙外轮廓的锯齿轮廓不同的是,DPPS将人类骨骼地形嵌入了锯齿前缘,有效地恢复了缺失的局部区域(例如,斜肢或运动-blurred parts),并加强了解剖必需关节的代表性. 这种骨架制导的浓缩提供了几何认识的前置,稳定了硅膜的质量并引导了对齐. 此外,DPPS通过将结构语义与silhouette轮廓连接起来,大大增加了输入的信息entropy,使下游网络能够以有限的可接受字段捕捉到更多的运动提示.

blocks.en: To further evaluate the generalization ability of DPAGait, we conduct cross-dataset experiments among SUSTech1K, Gait3D, and CCPG. Following the cross-domain protocol in DPGait [ 15 ] , each model is trained only on the source dataset and evaluated directly on an unseen target dataset, without target-domain fine-tuning or adaptation. As shown in Table 5 , DPAGait consistently outperforms SMPLGait and DPGait across all reported cross-dataset settings. For example, when trained on Gait3D and evaluated on SUSTech1K, DPAGait achieves an overall Rank-1 accuracy of 47.3%, compared with 33.8% for SMPLGait. When trained on CCPG and evaluated on Gait3D, DPAGait improves Rank-1 accuracy from 8.6% to 28.8%. These results provide further evidence that DPAGait can learn gait representations that transfer more effectively across unseen dataset domains.
blocks.zh: 为了进一步评价DPAGait的通用能力,我们在SUSTech1K、Gait3D和CCPG之间进行了跨数据集实验。 遵循DPGait [15] 的跨域协议,每个模型只接受关于源数据集的培训,并直接在一个看不见的目标数据集上评价,没有目标域的微调或适应. 如表5所示,DPAGait在所有报告跨数据集设置中的业绩始终高于SMPLGait和DPGait。 例如,在接受Gait3D培训并接受SUSTech1K评价时,DPAGait的总的排名1精度为47.3%,而SMPLGait的精度为33.8%。 在接受CCPG培训并接受Gait3D评价时,DEAGait将Rank-1的精度从8.6%提高到28.8%. 这些结果提供了进一步的证据,表明政治部可以学习更有效地跨越不见踪影的数据集域的动作。

blocks.en: 4.7.1 Effectiveness of Dynamic Pose-Parsing Encoding
blocks.zh: 4.7.1 动态松塞编码的有效性

blocks.en: To further investigate the contribution of the dynamic pose-parsing encoding, we evaluate DPPS across different temporal window lengths while keeping the stride fixed at s = 1 s=1 . The stride is kept unchanged to maintain a consistent temporal sampling density and a comparable number of generated dynamic representations, because increasing the stride would reduce the number of generated samples. As shown in Table 6 , the best performance is achieved with n = 3 n=3 , obtaining Rank-1 accuracies of 81.3%, 85.9%, and 81.1% on SUSTech1K, CCPG, and Gait3D, respectively. Compared with static PPS, RankSVM-based dynamic encoding provides further improvements, particularly on Gait3D. When the window length is further increased to n = 4 n=4 , the performance slightly decreases, indicating that an excessively long local window may weaken the modeling of fine-grained short-term gait dynamics. Therefore, we adopt n = 3 n=3 and s = 1 s=1 as the default settings.
blocks.zh: 为了进一步调查动态平面编码的贡献,我们评价DPPS跨越不同时间窗口长度,同时将脚步固定在s=1s=1. 脚步保持不变,以保持一个一致的时间采样密度和相当数量的生成动态表示,因为增加脚步将减少生成样本的数量。 如表6所示,成绩最佳的是n=3n=3,在SUSTech1K、CCPG和Gait3D上分别获得81.3%、85.9%和81.1%。 与静态PPS相比,基于RankSVM的动态编码提供了进一步的改进,特别是在Gait3D上. 当窗口长度进一步增加到n = 4 n = 4时,性能稍有下降,表明局部窗口过长可能会削弱精细的短期速度动态的模型化. 因此,我们将n=3 n=3和s=1 s=1作为默认设置.

blocks.en: 4.7.2 Effectiveness of Dual-Branch Architecture
blocks.zh: 4.7.2 双重界限结构的有效性

blocks.en: As shown in Table 7 , in single-stream settings using either traditional silhouettes ( Sche.1 ) or skeletons ( Sche.2 ) as input modalities, the recognition performance is relatively lower, highlighting the limitations of sparse structural cues in representing gait identity. Taking PPS with static explicit pose parsing ( Sche.3 ) as input leads to some improvement, indicating partial benefits from skeletal priors. When replacing the silhouette with our proposed DPPS representation ( Sche.4 ), the accuracy improves further. This validates that DPPS provides higher information entropy and more explicit dynamic motion cue guidance for gait recognition.
blocks.zh: 如表7所示,在单流设置中,使用传统的silhouettes(Sche.1)或骨架(Sche.2)作为输入模式,识别性能相对较低,凸显了稀疏结构提示在代表步态身份上的局限性. 使用静态显式的PPS来进行剖析(Sche.3),作为输入会导致一些改进,表明从骨骼前科中得到的部分好处. 在用我们提议的DPPS代表(Sche.4)来取代斜线时,准确性进一步提高。 这证实了DPPS为速度识别提供了更高的信息py和更加明确的动态运动提示指导.

blocks.en: We then introduce the 3D SMPL branch ( Sche.5 ) and achieve the best results. The 3D SMPL branch enhances the network in several key aspects: (i) Occlusion robustness. The strong statistical priors of SMPL regularize partial or noisy observations, enabling plausible full-body reconstruction even when limbs are missing or self-occluded. (ii) Appearance invariance. Operating in a clothing-agnostic mesh space effectively suppresses interference from garments or carried items. (iii) Viewpoint normalization. 3D articulation in canonical coordinates mitigates variations caused by camera perspective. (iv) Behavioral stability. Temporal pose parameters θ \theta encode identity-consistent motion dynamics such as stride and cadence. Through this complementary integration and collaborative modeling, the dual-branch framework jointly exploits dynamic 2D cues and stable 3D behavioral priors, yielding more discriminative and environment-invariant gait representations for real-world scenarios.

blocks.en: Incorporating the SMPL branch yields varying performance gains across datasets, as shown in Table 7 . This variation may be attributed to the dataset-dependent complementarity between the 2D DPPS representation and 3D SMPL-based motion cues. The 3D pose dynamics may provide a larger additional benefit for SUSTech1K. Importantly, the overall performance gain does not arise solely from DPPS. As shown in Table 2 and Table 3 , under the same Sils+SMPL inputs, DPAGait outperforms SMPLGait by 7.9, 18.9, and 28.2 percentage points on SUSTech1K, CCPG, and Gait3D, respectively, further demonstrating the effectiveness of the proposed dual-branch framework.
blocks.zh: 如表7所示,将SMPL分支纳入各数据集会产生不同的绩效收益。 这种变化可能归因于2D DPPS表示和基于3D SMPL的运动提示之间的依赖数据集互补. 3D能为SUSTech1K带来更大的额外好处。 重要的是,总体业绩收益不仅仅来自DPPS。 如表2和表3所示,在Sils+SMPL投入下,DPAGait在SUSTech1K、CCPG和Gait3D的成绩分别比SMPLGait高出7.9、18.9和28.2个百分点,进一步证明了拟议的双分支框架的有效性。

blocks.en: As summarized in Table 8 , our proposed Residual Attention Fusion module consistently achieves the best Rank-1 accuracy across all three datasets, outperforming representative fusion strategies including Mean, Concatenation, SMPLGait-style fusion, and Attention Fusion methods. This performance gain highlights the importance of jointly modeling complementary cues from DPPS and SMPL features while avoiding the feature dilution or misalignment issues commonly observed in naive fusion schemes.
blocks.zh: 如表8所概述,我们提议的剩余注意力聚合模块在所有三个数据集中始终达到最佳的Rank-1精度,超过具有代表性的聚合战略,包括Mean、Concatenation、SMPLGait式聚变和注意力聚合方法。 这一性能增益突出表明,必须共同从DPPS和SMPL的特性中建模互补的提示,同时避免在天真的聚变计划中常见的特性稀释或错配问题。

blocks.en: The limitations of the alternative fusion baselines are interpretable. First, Mean and Concatenation fusion implicitly treat DPPS and SMPL as equally reliable sources and aggregate them uniformly. This coarse integration tends to wash out fine-grained, modality-specific cues, and it cannot adaptively down-weight noisy signals. Second, SMPLGait-style Fusion reshapes the silhouette and SMPL features onto the same spatial grid forcibly and then performs element-wise multiplication. While this design enforces a strict alignment between the two streams, the aggressive spatial warping can distort the original SMPL representation and partially destroy its physically meaningful structure, leading to information loss. Additionally, the Attention Fusion method improves upon integration by learning element-wise importance weights and applying a weighted-sum aggregation. However, the absence of a residual pathway makes the fusion process prone to instability: it may oversuppress informative motion cues or over-amplify noisy activations, as shown by the visualization heatmap in Fig. 5 . In contrast, our RAFusion introduces a learnable residual-attention mechanism that models the difference between modalities while preserving essential identity cues. This design enables the network to selectively compensate for missing or unreliable information, rather than averaging or blindly attending to features. The residual formulation stabilizes optimization and maintains structural consistency, particularly when one modality becomes unreliable.
blocks.zh: 可解释替代聚变基线的局限性。 首先,平均和协和聚变含蓄地将DPPS和SMPL视为同样可靠的来源,并统一汇总. 这种粗糙的融合往往会冲出精细的,模式特有的提示,它不能适应下重量的噪音信号. 第二,SMPLGait风格的Fusion将silhouette和SMPL的特性强制重塑到同一个空间网格上,然后进行元素的乘法. 虽然这种设计在两条溪流之间执行严格的对齐,但侵略性的空间扭曲可能会扭曲原始的SMPL代表,并部分破坏其物理上有意义的结构,导致信息丢失. 此外,通过学习元素重要性权重和采用加权总和法,注意力融合法在整合后得到改善。 然而,由于缺少剩余路径,聚变过程容易出现不稳定:它可能会过度压强信息运动提示或过度放大噪音激活,如Fig的可视化热图所示. 5 (英语). 与此相反,我国的叛乱引入了可学习的留守机制,在保留基本身份提示的同时,模拟模式之间的差异。 这种设计使得网络能够有选择地补偿缺失或不可靠的信息,而不是平均或盲目地关注特征. 剩余配方稳定了优化并保持了结构一致性,特别是在一种方式变得不可靠时。

blocks.en: Beyond quantitative improvements, the qualitative heatmap visualization in Fig. 5 further demonstrates the superiority of RAFusion. Under normal conditions, RAFusion produces clear and compact activation responses around limb-swing and torso regions, which are well aligned with key discriminative gait cues. Under occlusion or night illumination, baseline fusion methods exhibit dispersed or noisy activations, while RAFusion continues to highlight coherent and semantically meaningful regions. This suggests that RAFusion effectively mitigates modality noise and preserves behavior-related dynamics, validating its role as a robust and adaptive fusion mechanism for multi-modal gait recognition.
blocks.zh: 除了数量上的改进外,图5的定性热映射可视化还进一步表明RAFSUG的优越性. 在正常情况下,气旋在肢翼和躯干区域周围产生清晰而紧凑的激活反应,这些反应与关键的歧视性动作提示非常一致。 在隔离或夜间照明下,基线聚变方法显示出分散或吵闹的激活,而RAPusion则继续凸显出连贯和有实质意义的区域. 这表明狂暴有效地缓解了模式噪声,保留了与行为相关的动态,验证了它作为一个强大和适应性强的聚变机制的作用,促进多式联运的步态识别.

blocks.en: 5 Conclusion
blocks.zh: 5 结论

blocks.en: In this work, we propose a dynamic pose-knowledge-aware gait recognition framework, which integrates DPPS representation and SMPL-driven modeling. This design effectively enhances the robustness and accuracy of gait recognition in complex real-world scenarios. The DPPS module enriches the input modality with structural semantics, while the 3D SMPL branch facilitates the learning of identity-discriminative behavioral motion cues. Extensive experiments on multiple benchmark datasets validate the effectiveness and generalizability of the proposed method. In future work, we plan to explore more efficient strategies for modeling joint-level motion patterns and develop finer-grained, learnable human parsing mechanisms, as well as a better fusion strategy, to further enhance the expressiveness of multimodal gait representation and fusion.
blocks.zh: 在这项工作中,我们提出一个动态的姿态知识意识快速识别框架,该框架将DPPS代表制和SPPL驱动的模型化结合起来. 这种设计在复杂的现实世界情景中有效地增强了速度识别的稳健性和准确性. DPPS模块用结构语义来丰富输入模式,而3D SMPL分支则有利于学习身份-区别行为动作提示. 多种基准数据集的广泛实验验证了拟议方法的有效性和通用性。 在今后的工作中,我们计划探索更有效的战略,以模拟联合运动模式,并发展精细、可学习的人类解析机制,以及更好的聚变战略,以进一步加强多式联运的聚变和聚变的表现形式。
